To determine the total amount of sugar Mason needs, we calculate the sugar required for each type of treat separately and then sum them up.

**Step 1: Calculate the sugar needed for the suckers.**
Mason needs 30 ounces of sugar for one batch of suckers.
He is making 8 batches of suckers.
$$ 8 \text{ batches} \times 30 \text{ ounces/batch} = 240 \text{ ounces} $$

**Step 2: Calculate the sugar needed for the fudge.**
Mason needs 70 ounces of sugar for one batch of fudge.
He is making 1 batch of fudge.
$$ 1 \text{ batch} \times 70 \text{ ounces/batch} = 70 \text{ ounces} $$

**Step 3: Calculate the total sugar needed.**
Add the sugar for the suckers and the sugar for the fudge together.
$$ 240 \text{ ounces} + 70 \text{ ounces} = 310 \text{ ounces} $$
